title: ASP Config Schema
description: Clingo solver options for the Clingo for VSCode extension. Read by 'Import from config.json' in the panel's solver settings, which is what carries the options into a run. Composing a program out of several files does not need this file: use #include "other.lp". in the program itself.

additionalFiles.description: Extra files to solve together with the program, relative to this config. Entries may be globs such as instances/*.lp

verboseMode.description: Only has an effect with your own clingo from PATH: the bundled solver never carries this output

solveLimit.description: Stops the search after this many conflicts or restarts. 0 means no limit.

stats.description: How much solver statistics clingo reports, 0 to 2. 0 is off

outputFormat.description: Which output format to ask clingo for: 0 default text, 1 competition, 2 JSON, 3 none. 2 is the default and the only one the panel can read answers out of. Only applies to your own clingo from PATH; the bundled solver always uses 2

preProcessor.description: Only works with your own clingo from PATH: the preprocessor emits aspif text rather than the JSON the bundled solver returns

models.description: How many answer sets to compute at most. 0 means all of them. Caps "Compute all Answer Sets"; "Compute the first Answer Set" always returns one
